text: Let us plan the week for the pilot: dogfood it on one real topic.

[fixture] Understood. Run /model chat morrow: it pins chat to the local model.
model for chat switched to morrow (pinned)
Which documents do I collect first?

[fixture] No. chat is pinned to morrow, so a failure stays a failure. Even unpinned, a local candidate never falls back to a cloud one unless the role allows it.
Good. Then list the three steps for this week.
